outcome: Duration of hospitalization in the intensive care unit (ICU)
Length of time antibiotics were administered
cohort: Neonates aged 28 days or less requiring antibiotic therapy for suspected infections.
finding: Procalcitonin-guided antibiotic therapy significantly reduced the duration of ICU stay (9.88 vs 11.3 days), antibiotic treatment (5.91 vs 7.28 days), and mortality (16.0% vs 27.4%) in critically ill neonates compared to standard care, without significant differences in reinfection rates or antibiotic complications.
gest_age: Mean gestational age of 38.31 +/- 2.41 weeks in the procalcitonin group and 38.08 +/- 2.03 weeks in the standard group.
